explanation: Controlled offline reference test passed. The environment recipe (neurokit2==0.2.13 plus matplotlib, on Python 3.13) was installed via uv, stage-inputs.sh staged the dataset /inputs/bio_resting_5min_100hz.csv (1,784,368 bytes, sha256 6a33ff8a..., downloaded from the pinned source revision's data URL and verified byte-identical by the controller), and the full original analysis ran offline in ~6s with exit code 0. All four declared artifacts were produced: hrv_time.csv (570 B), hrv_frequency.csv (258 B), hrv_nonlinear.csv (1,968 B), hrv_indices.csv (2,796 B), written by the frozen export code with no recomputation. Headless rendering was handled by the controller's MPLBACKEND=Agg plus a pre-built matplotlib font cache in /work/cache; all show=True plot calls were retained. The staged input was confirmed unchanged after the run (staged_inputs_verified: true). A passing test means the script completed and declared files were produced; it does not by itself establish scientific fidelity of the HRV values.
source_adaptations: analysis.py line 38: replaced 'data = nk.data("bio_resting_5min_100hz")' with 'data = nk.pd.read_csv("/inputs/bio_resting_5min_100hz.csv")' so the identical dataset file is read from the staged offline path instead of being downloaded by nk.data(). I verified in the installed neurokit2 0.2.13 source that nk.data() prefixes its GitHub URL onto every non-URL argument (a local path yields a 404), that only full remote URLs are read directly (which would need network at analysis time), and that nk.pd is theoriginal pandas module imported by neurokit2; therefore no import statements were changed or added. I confirmed the staged file's parsed DataFrame is exactly equal (df.equals) to what the original remote fetch returns, so the bytes consumed are unchanged.

stage-inputs.sh downloads the dataset during network-enabled setup from the pinned source revision URL (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neuropsychology/NeuroKit/ff419d983568ef492eb8d229af643c0ef0100b32/data/bio_resting_5min_100hz.csv) into /inputs and pre-builds a matplotlib font cache in /work/cache/matplotlib-config with backend Agg (headless rendering environment setting only; no scientific change).
unresolved_assumptions: The dataset CSV at the pinned revision is assumed to be the authoritative content of nk.data("bio_resting_5min_100hz"); this is supported by comparing the installed package's nk.data() source (it fetches .../data/<dataset>.csv from the same repo) and by byte-verification of the staged file, but the repo's master branch (which the released package fetches) was not separately diffed against the pinned revision for this file.

HRV numeric values were not independently recomputed; only execution success, artifact presence and input integrity were verified. Whether the 6-second runtime and produced tables match a canonical execution is for later grading.
